items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he and Donald Harrison did... played in the marching band, but also studied with Alvin Batiste

ctx.x: They did that – Let’s see. Branford graduated first from high school. When he finished – was it? ’78, I think. Somewhere around there – he went to Southern University in Baton Rouge. In fact he and Donald Harrison did. When they finished, they both went to Southern University in Baton Rouge and played in the marching band, but also studied with Alvin Batiste, because Bat was at Southern at the time. Branford stayed at Southern I think for a year. I think it was a year, two at the most, and he went to Berklee in…
Then while in Blakey’s band, somehow Branford ended up in Blakey’s band as well.
